_notes.strength: Set score >= riseAt: strength +1. Score below fallBelow: strength -1. In between: unchanged.
_notes.spacingDays: Days until a topic is due again, indexed by the NEW strength (0..5).
_notes.riseOnlyWhenDue: If true, practising a topic before it is due cannot raise its strength (stops farming).
_notes.xpPerMark: XP per mark, paid once per question per student. Set 0 to switch practice XP off.
_notes.dailyXpCap: Most XP a student can earn from practice sets in one day.
